project: Des Moines AI Pulse — Android Feature Parity & Hardening
description: Complete build-out plan to bring the native Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, MVVM, Hilt) to feature parity with the heavily-audited iOS SwiftUI app and to mirror the iOS audit-hardening layer. The Android v1 foundation (Home, Restaurants, Attractions, Search, Map, Favorites, Auth, Profile, Onboarding, Subscription/Play Billing, push/local notifications, Room cache, glassmorphism design system) is already complete (see prd-android.json). This PRD adds the missing iOS feature surfaces and shared services, then a cross-cutting hardening pass. Stories are grounded in the iOS source under ios/DesMoinesInsider/ and reuse the existing Supabase backend (same edge functions, RPCs, and tables across web/iOS/Android). Epics: (0) shared infra/services, (1) AI features, (2) discovery & engagement, (3) content, (4) monetization & ads, (5) search enhancements, (6) cross-cutting hardening. Backward compatibility: additive backend only — reuse existing edge functions/RPCs; do not alter shapes older iOS/web clients depend on (see CLAUDE.md).

userStories.title: Port QueryCache: file-backed LRU response cache
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable on-disk cache so feature screens can serve content on offline cold-start and reduce redundant network calls, matching iOS QueryCache.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: Create QueryCache (Hilt singleton) storing JSON in Context.cacheDir under a 'query-cache' subdir
get(key, allowStale): return value if within per-key TTL; if allowStale && offline, return expired value; else null
set(key, value, ttlMinutes): write JSON payload + stored-at timestamp; default TTL = Config.CACHE_EXPIRATION_MINUTES (5)
Enforce ~50 MB disk budget with LRU eviction by file mtime on write
Prune entries older than 24h on app launch; clear() wipes all (called on sign-out)
kotlinx.serialization used for encode/decode; corrupt entries are dropped, never crash
Unit tests cover TTL expiry, allowStale-on-offline, and LRU eviction
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/DesMoinesInsider/Services/QueryCache.swift. Used by Weekend, Hubs, Articles, Hotels, Deals, BestOf for offline cold-start (key examples: 'weekend-events', 'hub-events-{id}').

userStories.title: Port NetworkRetry: exponential-backoff retry wrapper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a global suspend retry helper so transient failures recover gracefully, matching iOS NetworkRetry.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: withRetry(maxAttempts=3) { block } suspend wrapper returning the block result
Backoff delay = base(1s) * 2^attempt + random jitter (0..500ms)
Retry only on 5xx, 429, and transport errors (timeout, connection lost, DNS, TLS)
Never retry 4xx (except 429), CancellationException, or non-transient errors
Respect coroutine cancellation before and after each delay
Log each retry attempt + delay via AppLogger; throw last error after max attempts
Unit tests cover success-after-retry, no-retry-on-4xx, and cancellation
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/DesMoinesInsider/Services/NetworkRetry.swift. Wrap Supabase reads in repositories with this.

userStories.title: Build AnalyticsService facade over Firebase Analytics
userStories.description: As a product owner, I need consistent, consent-gated analytics so feature usage and conversions are measurable across platforms, matching iOS AnalyticsService.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: AnalyticsService (Hilt singleton) wraps FirebaseAnalytics.getInstance()
All events gated behind ConsentService.analyticsConsent; dropped when consent is false
Track app_open, screen_view(screen), search(query_length, result_count), save_favorite(item_type)
Track paywall_present/paywall_dismiss/paywall_purchase_start with a context id for per-surface conversion
Mirror iOS event names + parameter keys exactly; no PII (no email, raw query, or user id)
Provide logScreen() and logEvent(name, params) helpers used by ViewModels
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/DesMoinesInsider/Services/AnalyticsService.swift. Existing Android AnalyticsService is skeletal — wire Firebase + consent gate.

userStories.title: Build CrashReportingService: first-party crash + non-fatal queue
userStories.description: As a developer, I need crash capture so production stability is observable, matching iOS CrashReportingService.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: Install a global Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler on app startup that chains to the previous handler
Persist uncaught exceptions (message + stack + timestamp + anonymized user id) as JSON files in filesDir/CrashReports
recordError(throwable, context) persists non-fatal errors with custom key/value context
pendingRecords() lists unsent records; flushPendingRecords() drains and deletes them
Cap queue at ~200 records (drop oldest); survive process death and reload on next launch
Set anonymized (hashed, 16-char) user id for attribution; respect analytics consent
Reserve POST to future 'crash-report' edge function behind a flag (not wired yet)
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/DesMoinesInsider/Services/CrashReportingService.swift. Android has no POSIX signal handler equivalent — VM-level uncaught handler is the analog. Could later swap to Crashlytics.

userStories.title: Version check + ForceUpdate blocking screen
userStories.description: As the business, I need to force-upgrade unsupported app versions so retired clients can be cut off safely, matching iOS VersionCheckService + ForceUpdateView and the CLAUDE.md force-update flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Call 'version-check' edge function on launch (pre-auth) with { platform: 'android', version: BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME }
Parse { minSupportedVersion, latestVersion, forceUpgrade, updateAvailable, storeUrl, message }
If forceUpgrade: show blocking ForceUpdateScreen (no dismiss/back) with message + 'Update Now' opening storeUrl in Play Store
If updateAvailable && !forceUpgrade: show a dismissible update banner
Fail open: any network/parse error leaves forceUpgrade=false and does not block the app
BackHandler is consumed on the force-update screen so it cannot be bypassed
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/DesMoinesInsider/Services/VersionCheckService.swift + Views/Components/ForceUpdateView.swift. Edge function 'version-check' already exists (REL-001 on iOS).

userStories.title: Port WeatherService (Open-Meteo, privacy-rounded)
userStories.description: As a user, I want current local conditions surfaced in discovery ribbons, matching iOS WeatherService.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch current conditions from api.open-meteo.com (keyless public API) for device location
Round latitude/longitude to 2 decimals (~1km) before the request; never send exact coordinates
Parse temperature_2m (F) + weather_code (WMO); map code to buckets (clear, cloudy, rain, snow, fog, thunder, unknown)
Cache result 30 min in DataStore (temp, condition, fetchedAt, lat, lon)
Return cached value when offline; return null only when no cache AND network fails
Skip refetch when location moved < 0.05 deg and cache age < 30 min
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/DesMoinesInsider/Services/WeatherService.swift. Feeds the optional 'Right Now' ribbon (RightNowRibbon) on Home/Dashboard.

userStories.title: Discover: swipe card deck core gestures + stack
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Tinder-style swipe deck to like/skip/boost events and restaurants, matching iOS Discover SwipeCardStack.
acceptanceCriteria: Render top 3 cards as a peek stack (back cards scaled ~0.96 + offset down ~14dp); reset uses a stack generation id
Modifier.pointerInput/detectDragGestures tracks live drag offset; commit threshold ~110dp or velocity > ~320dp/s
Left = skip (fly -700px X), right = like (+700px X), up = boost (-900px Y); easeOut ~0.28s
Overlay LIKE / NOPE / MORE-LIKE-THIS labels fade in with drag; boost plays a stronger haptic than left/right
Skip/Boost/Like action-bar buttons animate identical paths to the swipes
Honor system reduce-motion: drop rotation + spring overshoot but keep direct-manipulation drag
Tap card center opens detail and records a weak-positive signal
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/.../Views/Discover/SwipeCard.swift + SwipeCardStack.swift + DiscoverView.swift. Compose-specific gesture handling required (no UIKit DragGesture equivalent).

userStories.description: As an Insider+, I want to write reviews; as any user I want to report abuse, matching iOS review write paths.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Write a review' gated to authenticated + hasFeature(writeReviews) [Insider+]; otherwise show paywall on tap
Composer modal: required 1-5 star picker + optional text; if a review exists, switch to 'Edit your review' pre-filled
Submit upserts user_ratings on conflict (user_id, content_type, content_id) — atomic, no delete-then-insert; isSubmitting disables the button
Reload list + toast after submit; own review menu offers Edit + Delete (delete needs confirm; DELETE WHERE id AND user_id)
Other reviews offer Report -> insert rating_abuse_reports { rating_id, reported_by, reason } with confirmation toast
All writes require auth and respect RLS; failures show error toast, never crash
userStories.notes: Tables: user_ratings (upsert/delete), rating_abuse_reports (insert). Mirrors iOS RatingsService/VotingService. Atomic upsert mirrors iOS BUG-002. Depends on ANDP-035 + ANDP-043.

userStories.title: Best Of: categories hub
userStories.description: As a user, I want to browse community voting categories, matching iOS BestOfView.
acceptanceCriteria: Load voting_categories where is_active=true ordered by name; inject vote counts aggregated from votes (GROUP BY category_id)
List rows: icon, name, description, vote count; tap -> category detail
Loading = 6 skeleton rows; empty 'No Categories Yet'
Pull-to-refresh reloads categories and refreshes winner badges
First load cached for offline cold-start
userStories.notes: Tables: voting_categories, votes (count). Mirrors ios/.../Views/BestOf/BestOfView.swift + Services/BestOfWinners.swift. Reading free.

userStories.title: Best Of: voting booth + nominee search + write-in
userStories.description: As a signed-in user, I want to cast or change my vote in a category, matching iOS BestOfCategoryView booth.
acceptanceCriteria: Load the user's existing vote (votes where category_id AND user_id limit 1)
Signed-out: show sign-in prompt + CTA to Auth (soft funnel, no hard paywall)
Signed-in: search field (>=2 chars, ~300ms debounce) querying restaurants + attractions (5 each) -> nominee rows (image, name, type badge)
Show current pick status ('You voted for X — search or write in to change')
Write-in toggle accepts a non-empty custom entry (entityType='custom')
Cast vote upserts votes on conflict (category_id, user_id) — one atomic upsert (no transient zero-count); cast failure shows error banner
userStories.notes: Tables: votes (upsert), restaurants, attractions (nominee search). Mirrors ios/.../Views/BestOf/BestOfCategoryView.swift + Services/VotingService.swift. Atomic upsert mirrors iOS BUG-002.

userStories.title: Best Of: live leaderboard + optimistic updates + winner badges
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see standings update instantly and award badges app-wide, matching iOS Best Of leaderboard + BestOfWinners.
acceptanceCriteria: Load results (votes for category, aggregate by entity_id or custom_entry desc by count); batch-enrich restaurant/attraction name+image, fail-soft per type
Leaderboard rows: rank badge (medals top 3), image, name, vote-count bar, percentage, 'Your pick' highlight
Optimistic cast: immediately decrement old pick, increment new, re-sort; revert to snapshot on failure with error message
After cast or hub refresh, compute winners (entityId -> category-name map) and store in a BestOfWinners singleton (StateFlow)
Inject 'Best {Category}' award badges onto restaurant/attraction/event cards wherever those entities appear
Loading spinner; clamped vote bar widths (mirror iOS Best-Of vote bar fix)
userStories.notes: Tables: votes, voting_categories, restaurants, attractions. Mirrors iOS BestOf leaderboard + Services/BestOfWinners.swift. Bar clamp mirrors iOS audit fix (8cbed07).

userStories.title: Campaign ad serving + AdSlot component
userStories.description: As the business, I need first-party campaign ads in feed/detail placements, matching iOS CampaignAdService + AdSlot.
acceptanceCriteria: CampaignAdService fetches creatives via get_active_ads(p_placement_type) for placements (top_banner/featured_spot/below_fold/sponsored_listing)
5-minute per-placement cache; returns null when no live campaign; free tier only (null for Insider/VIP)
AdSlot composable renders title, image, CTA for feed and detail surfaces
Tapping the ad opens link_url through the safe external-link launcher (ANDP-063)
No ad rendered for premium tiers
Network/parse failure renders nothing (no error UI)
userStories.notes: RPC: get_active_ads. Tables: campaigns, campaign_creatives. Mirrors ios/.../Services/CampaignAdService.swift + Views/Components/AdSlot.swift/AdBannerView.swift.

userStories.title: Ad viewability + impression/click tracking + offline queue
userStories.description: As the business, I need accurate, consent-gated ad metrics, matching iOS AdTrackingService + AdViewabilityModifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewability modifier logs an impression only when an ad is >=50% on-screen for >=1s (Compose layout/onGloballyPositioned tracking)
Insert impressions to ad_impressions and clicks to ad_clicks (link click to impression_id when known)
De-dupe impressions per campaign+creative+session; frequency-cap (e.g. 3/campaign/session, 10/user/day) by querying ad_impressions before show
Respect ConsentService.analyticsConsent; drop queued events if consent revoked
Offline-safe queue in DataStore; flush on reconnect via NetworkMonitor
Emit matching analytics events (affiliate/sponsored/house with inventory_class tag)
userStories.notes: Tables: ad_impressions, ad_clicks. Mirrors ios/.../Services/AdTrackingService.swift + Views/Components/AdViewabilityModifier.swift. Mirrors iOS ad-viewability screen-bounds fix.

userStories.title: Sponsored picks in AI surfaces
userStories.description: As the business, I need labeled sponsored listings in AI flows, matching iOS SponsoredPickService + SponsoredPickCard.
acceptanceCriteria: SponsoredPickService calls get-sponsored-pick with { surface: ask_pulse|surprise_me|trip_planner, query? }
Free tier only: short-circuit locally (return null) for Insider/VIP before the network call; server re-checks via bearer token
SponsoredPickCard shows a clear 'Sponsored' label, title, reason, thumbnail, external-link icon
Log impression on view and click on tap via AdTrackingService; de-dupe per session per surface
Returns null gracefully when no sponsored inventory
userStories.notes: Edge function: get-sponsored-pick. Tables: campaigns, sponsored_listing_links. Mirrors ios/.../Services/SponsoredPickService.swift + Views/Components/SponsoredPickCard.swift. Consumed by ANDP-013/024.

userStories.title: Soft paywall service + contextual PaywallView
userStories.description: As the business, I want timely, capped upsells, matching iOS SoftPaywallService + PaywallView.
acceptanceCriteria: SoftPaywallService triggers after configured engagement (e.g. 2nd favorite OR first Trip Planner attempt); free tier only; resets on purchase
Frequency cap: max ~3 presentations ever with a ~7-day cooldown between shows (persisted)
PaywallView shows context-specific headline (favorites, Trip Planner, insider/dining tips) + tier comparison + Subscribe button -> SubscriptionScreen
Post-onboarding upsell shown at most once per session
Track paywall_present/dismiss/purchase_start with a context id
Free users retain graceful access to non-premium content
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/.../Services/SoftPaywallService.swift + Views/Subscription/PaywallView.swift. Reuses existing PremiumGate + SubscriptionScreen. Mirrors iOS FEAT-032/033 soft-paywall wiring.

userStories.title: Frequency-capped interstitial ads
userStories.description: As the business, I want occasional full-screen ads at safe boundaries, matching iOS InterstitialAdService.
acceptanceCriteria: InterstitialAdService gates full-screen ads at major nav boundaries (e.g. tab switch) for free tier only
Caps: max N per session, none in the first M sessions, minimum interval between shows
Persist session count, boundary count, last-shown timestamp in DataStore
Never show while reading or mid-flow; callers gate behind stable boundaries only
Mark presented after show and increment counters; no-op for premium
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/.../Services/InterstitialAdService.swift + Views/Components/InterstitialAdView.swift.

userStories.title: Saved searches CRUD + alert configuration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to save searches and get alerts, matching iOS SavedSearchService + SavedSearch UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch the user's saved_searches (RLS own-only) ordered created_at DESC; offline -> serve last-fetched local copy, re-sync on reconnect
Create with name, filters (JSONB), search_type ('event_list' for Events tab else 'advanced'), and top-level alerts_enabled mirrored from filters.alertsEnabled
Toggle alerts updates both top-level alerts_enabled and search_type so the nightly alert job can scan it
Delete is optimistic with confirm; on failure roll back the row and show an error toast
Tapping a saved search re-runs it (applies filters to the relevant tab)
Surfaced in Search and embedded in Dashboard
userStories.notes: Table: saved_searches. Mirrors ios/.../Services/SavedSearchService.swift + Views/Search/SavedSearchUI.swift/SavedSearchResultsView.swift. Optimistic-delete rollback mirrors iOS audit (d7cead5).

userStories.title: Search suggestions: trending + recent + recently-viewed
userStories.description: As a user, I want helpful suggestions in the empty search state, matching iOS SearchSuggestions.
acceptanceCriteria: Trending chips row (e.g. Live music, Kid-friendly, Brunch, Free, This weekend)
Recent searches list (last 5 from SearchHistoryService) with a clear-all action
Recently-viewed horizontal rail (RecentlyViewedService) with thumbnails + titles
Tapping a trending chip or recent query populates the field and submits
Tapping a recently-viewed item navigates to its detail
All read-only / on-device (no network)
userStories.notes: Mirrors ios/.../Views/Components/SearchSuggestions.swift. Depends on ANDP-007 + ANDP-008.

userStories.title: Atomic favorite toggles (no double-write race)
userStories.description: As a user, rapid favorite taps must never duplicate or desync, mirroring the iOS atomic-upsert audit fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard FavoritesRepository toggle with a per-item Mutex so local cache write + remote call are atomic
Optimistic local update with rollback on remote failure
Remote write uses upsert (not delete-then-insert) to avoid transient states
Unit test: 10 concurrent toggles on one id result in one consistent final state + a single effective remote write
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS BUG-002 (atomic vote upsert) applied to favorites. Files: data/repository/FavoritesRepositoryImpl.kt.

userStories.title: Serialize/cancel async fetches to kill stale-result races
userStories.description: As a user, overlapping loads must not show stale data, mirroring the iOS BUG-007 fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce a per-endpoint fetch generation/cancellation so a newer request cancels the in-flight one
Apply to Events, Restaurants, Favorites, Search, and Discover fetches
Only the latest request's result updates UI state
Restore any throttle/debounce removed during the change (mirror iOS a972e23 follow-up)
Integration test: rapid filter changes + pull-to-refresh yield only the latest result
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS BUG-007 + the prefetch-throttle restore. ViewModels under ui/screens/*.

userStories.title: Pagination consistency validation
userStories.description: As a user, paginated lists must not silently corrupt, mirroring the iOS pagination-desync fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate response size <= requested limit; detect offset overlap with the previous page
On mismatch, emit an error state + reload affordance instead of appending bad data
Apply to Events, Restaurants, Articles, Hotels list loads
Unit test: oversized/overlapping mock responses trigger the guard
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS pagination desync fix (d7cead5). Carries forward AUDIT-PERF concerns.

userStories.title: Crash-safe external link + Maps handling with allowlist
userStories.description: As a user, opening links/maps must never crash, mirroring the iOS crash-safe Maps audit fix.
acceptanceCriteria: SafeLinkLauncher validates URIs and resolves an Intent before launch; catches ActivityNotFound
Maps fallback chain: geo: intent -> Google Maps -> browser
Allowlist app domains + map schemes; drop unsafe/unknown schemes
Route all article/ad/detail external links through SafeLinkLauncher
Unit test: malformed URL falls back safely; disallowed scheme is rejected
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS d9dd6ac (crash-safe Maps links, ad-link allowlist). Used by ANDP-031/034/040.

userStories.title: Sign-out complete teardown (no leaks)
userStories.description: As a user, signing out must fully reset state, mirroring the iOS sign-out leak fix.
acceptanceCriteria: signOut() stops SessionTimeoutService, unregisters NetworkMonitor + push token, cancels in-flight jobs
Clear SecureStorage tokens, cached profile, recently-viewed/search history if required, and image cache
No retained listeners/observers after sign-out
Test verifies repositories/services are reset and no callbacks remain registered
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS d9dd6ac sign-out leak fix. Files: AuthViewModel, SessionTimeoutService, NetworkMonitor, PushNotificationService.

userStories.title: Affiliate ad-link allowlist + remote config
userStories.description: As the business, affiliate links must only open approved domains, mirroring the iOS ad-link allowlist.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend AffiliateAdService registry to all current partners; add isValidAffiliateUrl(url) domain check
Every affiliate launch validates against the registry before opening
Log + drop rejected (non-allowlisted) domains
Allowlist updatable via remote config without an APK rebuild
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS ad-link allowlist (d9dd6ac). Files: ui/components/AffiliateAdBanner.kt + a new AffiliateAdService.

userStories.title: Enforce 48dp minimum touch targets
userStories.description: As a user with motor/vision needs, all controls must be reliably tappable, mirroring the iOS 44pt-target fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply minHitTarget()/minimumInteractiveComponentSize to icon buttons, tab icons, filter chips, map controls
Audit EventDetail, RestaurantDetail, Search, Map, Profile screens
Default IconButton size >= 48x48dp with padding
Snapshot/UX test at large font scale confirms no clipped/under-sized targets
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS 44pt target fix (d9dd6ac) -> Android 48dp (WCAG 2.5.5). AccessibilityModifiers.kt already exposes minHitTarget().

userStories.title: Telemetry opt-out enforcement
userStories.description: As a privacy-conscious user, revoking analytics must actually stop non-essential telemetry, mirroring the iOS universal opt-out.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate all non-essential analytics/ad events behind ConsentService.analyticsConsent
Never gate essential crash/auth-error telemetry
Settings exposes an opt-out that calls ConsentService and clears queued analytics/ad events
Test: revoke consent, exercise app, verify no analytics/ad-impression writes
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS SEC-014 universal analytics opt-out. Ties into ANDP-003/041.

userStories.title: Comprehensive accessibility labels + semantic hierarchy
userStories.description: As a TalkBack user, I need meaningful, ordered labels, mirroring the iOS accessibility audit batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Use aggregated card labels (title/date/venue/price) instead of many separate reads
Apply heading semantics to screen + section titles; contentDescription on all icon-only buttons
Make star ratings keyboard/AT-operable; label search/filter inputs (mirror web WEB-UX-024)
Audit EventDetail, RestaurantDetail, Search, Profile, Discover with TalkBack and fix reading order
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS UX-039..047 accessibility batch. AccessibilityModifiers.kt/AccessibilityHelper.kt exist but aren't applied systematically.

userStories.title: Auto-refetch stale queries on reconnect
userStories.description: As a user returning online, content should refresh itself, mirroring iOS NWPathMonitor-driven refetch.
acceptanceCriteria: Observe NetworkMonitor reconnect signal; debounce ~500ms then refresh currently-visible queries only
Wire into Events, Restaurants, Favorites (avoid refetching all pages)
Optional subtle banner/toast during refetch
Test: offline -> online toggle refreshes the visible list
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS reconnect behavior. NetworkMonitor already exposes a reconnect state; wire it to repositories.

userStories.title: Index attractions (and hotels) into App Search
userStories.description: As a user, I want on-device search to find all content types, mirroring the iOS Spotlight indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend AppSearchService to index attractions and hotels alongside events/restaurants
Index on content fetch (Home/Restaurants/Attractions/Hotels load) with name, description, deep-link URL, image, keywords
Tapping a system-search result deep-links into the correct detail screen
Settings toggle to disable on-device indexing
userStories.notes: Mirrors iOS Spotlight work (3a677fa). AppSearchService currently covers events + restaurants only.

userStories.title: Navigation polish: back-handled sheets + tab re-select scroll-to-top
userStories.description: As a user, navigation should feel native, carrying forward the open Android audit UX items.
acceptanceCriteria: BackHandler dismisses an open bottom sheet before popping the back stack
Re-selecting the active bottom-nav tab scrolls that screen's list to top
Apply consistently across Home, Restaurants, Search, Favorites
userStories.notes: Carries forward prd-android-audit.json AUDIT-UX-002/003 (still todo). Files: MainScreen.kt, NavGraph.kt.

userStories.title: Extract hardcoded strings to resources (i18n readiness)
userStories.description: As a developer, user-facing strings should live in resources, carrying forward the Android audit item.
acceptanceCriteria: Move hardcoded UI strings to res/values/strings.xml
Replace literals in screens/components with stringResource()
No behavior change; lint passes with no hardcoded-text warnings on migrated files
userStories.notes: Carries forward prd-android-audit.json AUDIT-UX-004 (todo).

userStories.title: Responsive tablet & landscape layouts
userStories.description: As a tablet user, layouts should adapt, carrying forward the Android audit item.
acceptanceCriteria: Use WindowSizeClass to switch to multi-column/list-detail layouts on expanded widths
Map, detail, and list screens render correctly in landscape and on tablets
NavigationRail used instead of bottom bar on expanded width (already partly present)
userStories.notes: Carries forward prd-android-audit.json AUDIT-UX-007 (todo).

userStories.title: Premium lock indicators on gated filters/options
userStories.description: As a free user, I should see what's premium before tapping, carrying forward the Android audit item.
acceptanceCriteria: Show a lock badge on premium filter options and premium-only toggles
Tapping a locked option opens the contextual paywall (ANDP-043)
Apply in FilterSheet and any premium event/restaurant filters
userStories.notes: Carries forward prd-android-audit.json AUDIT-UX-006 (todo). Ties into ANDP-043.
